_comment: Measured coverage produced by evaluation on the frozen factory split.
The Materials screen reads this file. Numbers are NOT typed into templates,
so the screen cannot drift from the measured values (Phase 2 report 4.7 / T-22).
Replace this file with the metrics file emitted by the evaluation run when the
final weights land; no template or Python change is required.

overall.note: Detection and class typing are reported separately and never merged into one number (NFR-08 / T-18).

model.latency_conditions: median over 500 runs, 256x256, one desktop CPU thread
model.activation: none in graph - softmax applied by the caller
model.arm_note: No ARM or phone latency measurement is currently claimed.

materials.notes: Best class typing, weakest geometry (clDice 0.529) - steel cracks are the thinnest in the corpus at about 4 px
